slice: Explain same-prefix initialization residuals and probe fixed reference/clock sensitivity without changing the estimator or adopting a state.
inputs: Original flatwall_01.bag and four immutable 64-pose startup sequences: raw legacy/fine from PR292 and gyro-compensated legacy/fine from PR293. All saved diagnostics and successful controllers remain unchanged.

configuration.imu_from_lidar: identity, declared prior configuration; no physical calibration is fitted

reference_stride_policy: Indices 0,stride,...,63 from the same 64 frozen poses, always preserving both endpoints and the same 6.3-second span. These exploratory reference policies are not adopted startup policies.
clock_sign: IMU integration timestamp = saved LiDAR reference timestamp + offset_ns; use checked integer addition, never float epoch conversion.
clock_scope: Only raw poses at stride 1 are probed for nonzero offsets. Gyro-compensated poses were formed with zero offset and are evaluated only at zero; no inconsistent reuse as a joint calibration.
independent_calculation: Decode standard ROS1 IMU, SciPy exact held-gyro bias fit, NumPy displacement-triple equations with fixed acceleration bias. Compare baseline diagnostic/estimate values to original independent outputs and every case acceptance/fit to the unchanged native initializer.
decomposition: Let A=diff(diff(p)/dt), B=-diff(R*delta_p/dt)-R*delta_v[:-1], alpha=(dt[:-1]+dt[1:])/2, P=I-alpha*alpha.T/(alpha.T*alpha). Velocity residual P*(A+B) must equal P*A+P*B. Report RMS of each term and signed cross energy without claiming which physical sensor caused the discrepancy.
residual_reporting: All per-edge rotation vectors and per-triple velocity residuals are preserved privately, with hashes. Report p50/p90/p99/max, top-1/top-5 squared-energy shares and source indices; no points/poses/equations are removed, smoothed or reweighted.
sensor_reporting: Record IMU sample timing/frame/gyro and acceleration-norm statistics on the covered prefix expanded by the fixed clock bounds. These are measurements, not noise or stationary calibration. No reference trajectory is parsed.
no_adoption: No limit/default change, physical accuracy or uncertainty claim, fitted clock/extrinsic/acceleration calibration, timing/GPU result, state adoption or causal diagnosis from sensitivity alone. Passing an exploratory decimated batch does not validate skipped references or establish full-rate physical initialization.
